Highlight colour for active tabs and buttons in menus that use the shared theme.
Menu height in pixels at 100 % scale (0 = the menu's default).
apex.config.custom-menu-exptable.mode.de: Apex: the table's items in Apex styling, filler panes removed, Hypixel's layout kept. Normal: Hypixel's own chest. Also needs the Experimentation Table Apex Menus switch.
apex.config.custom-menu-exptable.reset.d: Put this menu back to Apex with its default size, scale and colour.
apex.config.custom-menu-exptable.scale.d: Menu size in percent; it never grows past the screen.
apex.config.custom-menu-exptable.width.d: Menu width in pixels at 100 % scale (0 = the menu's default).
